question: Which is the first known instrument to measure the humidity of air or gas, built by Leonardo da Vinci around 1400?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hygrometer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A hygrometer is an instrument that is used in meteorological science for measuring the humidity or amount of water vapour in the air.
 
• The ideal range of humidity for Humans is between 30 and 50 percent.
 
• The relative humidity of the atmosphere is calculated by the hygrometer. It shows results in the percentage
 
• A hygrometer contains two thermometers one is called a dry bulb and the second is a wet bulb.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
